text: LIV Golf has been bankrolling the Asian Tour's International Series to the tune of $300 million, leaving the future of the elevated events - each offering $2 million in prize money and a pathway to LIV - in doubt after the Asian Tour's partnership with the PGA and DP World Tours; the Asian Tour said its priority was to maintain the International Series events planned for later in 2026 'in some form'.
short: LIV put about $300m into the International Series; its future was left in doubt by the split.
